pr_title: Fix spaces not being stripped in admin account search

issue_context.title: Regression: When searching for accounts in the admin interface, spaces are no longer stripped from username
issue_context.body:
### Steps to reproduce the problem

I just upgraded my instance from v3.5.5 to v4.0.2. 

As I spend a lot of time in the admin/moderation interface [searching for users](https://digitalcourage.social/admin/accounts) by username, I noticed that when copying and pasting usernames from another website into the search form, I now often get no result. The reason is that leading and trailing whitespace is no longer removed automatically before the lookup is performed.




### Expected behaviour

user search should be indifferent to leading or trailing whitespace

### Actual behaviour

whitespace before or after the username leads to no search result

### Detailed description

Please perform a `.strip` on the input before searching for the user in order to revert to the behaviour of Mastodon 3.

### Specifications

Mastodon 4.0.2
Ruby 3.0.4
LibreWolf 107 browser
instance: https://digitalcourage.social

review_comments: Why does value only need sanitizing with these scopes, but not the others?
